data.narrative:
Magrathea Metals is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Alex Grant and Jacob Brown that has raised $100M+. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is applicable and forms the basis of this analysis. Using the $100M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to later-stage progression, this approach yields an implied valuation of $200M. The peer-median method was not applicable; while eight same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints, making a narrow peer median unreliable and sector-wide medians potentially misleading given the heterogeneity of Climate & Energy business models and technologies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $170M to $230M, with a median of $200M. This range reflects the stage-progression methodology and incorporates a reasonable bandwidth around the point estimate to account for execution risk and market conditions. Key uncertainties include the lack of sufficiently comparable transaction data at this stage and tier within the sector, and the absence of detailed operational or commercial traction metrics. Investors should supplement this analysis with bottom-up revenue modeling and detailed technical due diligence before commitment.
